summary: The page demonstrates good visual styling and layout overall, but exhibits minor RTL text wrapping issues in the timeline ruler metadata and inverted shortcut key ordering in the keyboard helper.

issues.title: Bidi caption wrapping artifact
issues.description: The footer caption below the timeline ruler wraps awkwardly due to bidirectional text mixing with timestamp ranges.
issues.evidence: The string '02:00 - 00:00' and helper text wrap unevenly across two lines beneath the ruler.
issues.suggestion: Set proper directional isolation (dir='rtl' with unicode-bidi) or flex alignment for timestamp ranges.

issues.title: Inverted shortcut key sequence in RTL
issues.description: KbdGroup keys inherit RTL flow direction, causing modifier keys to appear after the action key in reading order.
issues.evidence: Shortcut displays visually as [⇧] [⌘] [K] left-to-right, placing 'K' first in RTL reading order.
issues.suggestion: Enforce LTR direction on KbdGroup containers for standard shortcut sequence display.
